algorithms.title: START Adult Triage
steps: Global: 'If you can walk, go to [green point].' → walkers = MINOR (green).
Non-walkers, one by one: Breathing? If NO → open/position airway.
Breathes after positioning → IMMEDIATE. Still apneic → DECEASED.
RR ≤ 30: check perfusion — radial pulse absent or CRT > 2 s → IMMEDIATE (control bleeding).
Perfusion OK: can follow simple commands? NO → IMMEDIATE. YES → DELAYED.

algorithms.title: JumpSTART Pediatric Triage
algorithms.description: For children ~1–8 years (or anyone who looks like a child).
steps: Walking → MINOR (non-walkers by development: run the algorithm; well-appearing with no significant injury may be MINOR).
Not breathing → position airway → breathes → IMMEDIATE.
Still apneic → palpable peripheral pulse? NO → DECEASED.
Pulse present → 5 rescue breaths (~15 s) → breathes → IMMEDIATE; still apneic → DECEASED.
RR 15–45: palpable peripheral pulse? NO → IMMEDIATE.
Pulse present: AVPU — U or inappropriate P → IMMEDIATE; A, V, or appropriate P → DELAYED.
